meta.subtitle: The broad functions needed to get a business off the ground. Rate how much you'd want to own each one — the board totals everyone's interest so we can see where the group leans and where the gaps are.

roles.title: Leadership & Strategy
roles.blurb: Vision, direction, big decisions, the business model and overall plan. The "where are we going and why" role.

roles.title: Product & Service
roles.blurb: Designing and building the actual thing we sell — development, quality, and deciding what to offer.

roles.title: Operations & Supply Chain
roles.blurb: Keeping the business running day-to-day: sourcing, suppliers, inventory, logistics, fulfilment, facilities.

roles.title: Sales & Business Development
roles.blurb: Winning customers and partners: pipeline, closing, new markets, account management, retention.

roles.title: Marketing & Communications
roles.blurb: Brand, digital marketing, content, social, PR and market research — getting attention and demand.

roles.title: Finance
roles.blurb: Bookkeeping, budgeting, cash flow, forecasting, fundraising and investor relations. The money role.

roles.title: People (HR)
roles.blurb: Hiring, payroll, benefits, training and culture — everything to do with the team.

roles.title: IT & Technology
roles.blurb: Website, systems, software and platforms, data and cybersecurity — all things digital.

roles.title: Legal & Compliance
roles.blurb: Entity structure, contracts, IP, licences, regulation, insurance and risk.

roles.title: Customer Support
roles.blurb: Serving customers after the sale — service, support and handling issues.
